2026-09-22 15:34:46.488491 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-09-22 15:34:46.488664 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-22 15:34:46.488675 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-22 15:34:46.488730 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-09-22 15:34:46.488782 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
